label: Experience
question_wording: What is your experience with software development?

label: Team size
question_wording: What is the size of your team?

label: Use of TD in the organization
question_wording: We use the term "Technical Debt" when communicating across the organization

label: Existing guidelines to manage TD
question_wording: In our organization, guidelines are available for guidance on how to manage Technical Debt

label: Percentage of time wasted because of TD
question_wording: On average, how much % of the total development time do you estimate was spent by your team(s) on extra activities due to the presence of Technical Debt in the system(s)?

label: Missed business opportunities
question_wording: We have missed business opportunities because of existing Technical Debt in the system(s) (e.g. we could not implement new features, new projects, we could not acquire new customers)

label: Encouragement from other managers — deliberately take on TD for benefits
question_wording: Other managers (inlcuding engineering managers) encourage my team to: [Deliberate taking on TD if they get benefits out of it (e.g. to speed up a delivery)]

label: Facilitation of education sessions
question_wording: I have facilitated and/or participated in knowledge sharing sessions on the management of TD (e.g. education sessions, seminars, interest groups inthecompany,etc.)

label: Clarity of budget responsibility
question_wording: It's clear for me and my team who is responsible to approve or deny budget (e.g. team capacity, team bandwidth) to remove TD

label: Follow-up on TD decisions
question_wording: Someone will check if I have successfully removed TD (e.g. by code reviews etc.) and how much time was spent on the activity (it could be a manger, an architect, another team member, etc.)

label: Understanding of TD risks
question_wording: It’s easy for me to understand if the current TD in the system(s) is risky (e.g. leading to negative consequences) or not

label: Systematic and iterative process
question_wording: My team iteratively engages in a systematic assessment (discussing costs, benefits and risks) of TD (this includes re-assessing known TD)

label: Dedicated time to manage TD — formal allocation
question_wording: We have formally allocated time for removing TD

label: Use of data and measurements
question_wording: We use data and measurements to assess TD costs and benefits

label: Tools chosen by teams
question_wording: Are the current tools in your organization to manage TD more chosen by the teams or more chosen as standard tools by the organization? (adjust the bar to one or the other extreme according to your experience with the tools that you can use to manage TD)

label: Clarity of technical responsibility
question_wording: It's clear for me and my team who is responsible for technical support if we need to add or remove TD that can affect other teams

label: Removal of TD
question_wording: To what extent do you remove code-TD before releasing the software?

label: Tracking of larger TD items
question_wording: We track the bigger TD issues in our official backlogs, together with details on their cost to remove and their risks if not removed (bigger issues are e.g. multiple architectural componentsthatmightaffectotherteams)

label: Helpfulness of code reviews
question_wording: I think that, in our organization, code reviews helps identifying TD

label: Confidence in code analyzers
question_wording: We confidently use the output of code analyzers to identify TD automatically and plan refactoring

label: Confidence in risk-assessment tools
question_wording: We confidently use the output of tools to identify the costs and risks associated to TD to prioritize its removal

label: Tools supporting TD level assessment and planning
question_wording: We confidently use the output of a tool to visualize the overall level of TD in our system(s), its costs and risks to plan future development
